The '''''Notices of the American Mathematical Society''''' is the membership [[Academic journal|journal]] of the [[American Mathematical Society]] (AMS), published monthly except for a combined June/July issue. Founded in 1953, it serves as the official magazine of record for the society and is distributed to approximately 30,000 AMS members worldwide, one-third of whom reside outside the United States. The AMS describes the ''Notices'' as one of "the world's most widely read journal aimed at professional mathematicians".<ref name=about/>

==Content==
Each issue of the ''Notices'' contains one or two expository articles describing current developments in mathematical research, written by professional mathematicians.<ref name=phys>{{cite web |title=Notices of the American Mathematical Society |url=https://phys.org/journals/notices-of-the-american-mathematical-society/ |website=Phys.org |access-date=26 January 2026}}</ref> The journal also carries articles on the [[history of mathematics]], [[mathematics education]], and professional issues facing mathematicians, along with reviews of books, plays, movies, and other artistic and cultural works involving mathematics.<ref name=phys/> Regular columns include ''Math Reviews News'', ''Washington Update'' on policy matters affecting mathematicians, and ''Short Stories'' exploring lesser-known mathematical results.<ref name="flapan-farewell">{{cite web |last1=Flapan |first1=Erica |title=From the Editor's Desk |url=https://www.ams.org/journals/notices/202411/noti3082/noti3082.html |website=Notices of the American Mathematical Society |date=December 2024 |access-date=26 January 2026}}</ref> The ''Early Career'' section provides advice to graduate students, postdocs, and junior mathematicians.<ref name="flapan-farewell"/>

Articles are [[peer review]]ed by an editorial board of mathematical experts.<ref name=about/> The cover regularly features [[mathematical visualization]]s.<ref name=about/> Each issue since January 1995 is available in its entirety on the journal's website.<ref name=about/>

==Editors==
The current [[editor-in-chief]], Mark C. Wilson, began his term with the January 2025 issue.<ref name=about/> He succeeded [[Erica Flapan]], who served as editor from 2019 to 2024.<ref name="flapan-farewell"/> Previous editors include Frank Morgan (2003–2018).<ref name="mathmore">{{cite web |title=Erica Flapan will be the new editor of the AMS Notices |url=http://mathismore.net/forum/phpBB3/viewtopic.php?f=13&t=1306 |website=Math is More |access-date=26 January 2026}}</ref>
